name: Vintage Black Birdcage Fascinator
description: An elegant vintage-style party hairpiece designed with a soft base topped with a delicate fabric flower, and light feathers. It is finished with a classic, wide-net birdcage veil that falls gently over the face for a royal look.
description2: It is lightweight, easy to clip into the hair, and holds securely for long events. This hairpiece can be customized in any color to perfectly match your dress.
